c1.note: The company release and the Oct 2026 ELG release confirm ELG, formerly Saks Global, is the group that includes Saks Fifth Avenue.

c5.note: The company description matches this wording exactly.

c7.note: Emergence from Chapter 11 on June 26, 2026 is confirmed by multiple sources; the event is older than 90 days.

c12.note: The court approved the plan on June 5; this is background history.

c14.note: The hbc.com text is stale: HBC spun off the Saks assets in 2024 and went bankrupt in 2025, and the Saks business is now owned by ELG.

c15.note: The claim comes from an outdated HBC page; HBC was liquidated in 2025 and its Canadian stores closed.

c16.note: HBC's Saks OFF 5TH ownership is outdated: the Saks Global spin-off moved it in 2024, and the e-commerce arm wound down during the bankruptcy, leaving 12 outlets.

c17.note: Saks's own about page states the 2021 HBC and Insight Partners standalone ecommerce partnership, which is historical context.

c18.note: Drapers says the group first filed in January 2026, and Wikipedia confirms the January 14 Chapter 11 filing.

c19.note: The company release cites a nearly 75% debt reduction on emergence.

c20.note: The press release says both firms partnered through the restructuring and each have two seats on the seven-person board; the 'former bondholders' wording is supported by other sources.

c22.note: Commercial Observer reports the two bondholders provided $1 billion in DIP financing.

c23.note: The DIP lenders exchanged their debt for equity and became the new controlling shareholders.

c24.note: The sources give only board seats and no equity split; this is an absence claim, so confidence is medium.

c25.note: Commercial Observer reports Baker bought Saks in 2013 for $2.9 billion, mainly debt, and Saks's own page confirms the November 2013 HBC acquisition.

c26.note: Drapers calls it shuttered, but the company still runs 12 OFF 5TH outlets; only the e-commerce site and most stores closed, so 'shuttered' overstates.

c27.note: Wikipedia says the acquisition was completed in December 2024 for $2.7 billion, but the buyer was Saks Global; the HBC attribution is loose, since HBC had already spun off its US assets into Saks Global.

c28.note: Wikipedia says Saks Global was formed in November 2024 when HBC's US assets were spun off, and Drapers agrees.

c29.note: Drapers states that HBC declared bankruptcy in June 2025.

c30.note: A company release dated October 29, 2026 quotes van Raemdonck as CEO, so he is still in the role.

c31.note: Commercial Observer says Baker resigned as HBC CEO by early 2026, and the WWD January 2026 citation supports it; this is background, not the parent-company answer.

c32.note: Wikipedia lists the New York HQ and the four subsidiaries (Saks Global Holdings LLC until June 2026), and the June 2026 company release confirms the rebrand to Exemplar Luxury Group; Pentwater and Bracebridge are the controlling owners.

c33.note: Saks Global was formed in 2024 with the Neiman Marcus acquisition and renamed Exemplar Luxury Group in June 2026, so older sources naming Saks Global are outdated.

c34.note: Off 5th shrank to 12 outlets, but the passages don't say they are used mainly to clear excess inventory, so only the cutback is supported; the answer to the parent-company question is unaffected.

c35.note: Wikipedia reports Amazon holding just over 23% and calling its stake 'now presumptively worthless'; this is pre-emergence history and not the current parent.

c15.note: This comes from an old HBC 'Our Company' page. Hudson's Bay went bankrupt and was liquidated in 2025, Canadian Tire bought the brand rights, and The Bay e-commerce marketplace no longer runs under HBC, so the claim is not current.

c20.note: Saks Global's emergence press release and Drapers both say Pentwater and Bracebridge each have two seats on the seven-person board and partnered with the company through the restructuring. The 'former bondholders' label is a small addition the sources don't state, but it doesn't conflict with them.

c28.note: Drapers says HBC spun off Saks Fifth Avenue, Bergdorf Goodman, Neiman Marcus and Saks Off 5th into Saks Global in 2024, which matches the Neiman Marcus deal closing in December 2024.
